rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>We are currently attempting to pass through the <book(41)>Sea of Lorelei<endbook()>.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>But on our course<thumbnail(219)>, <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> forces have been spotted. It seems they have already noticed us too.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>There is no time to take the long way around, so we will engage here. Prepare to launch.
<topic()><thumbdown()><operator(30070,1)><speed(2)>Everyone, please listen. I asked <color(4)>Jamil<ce()> for one favor.
<operator(30070,1)><speed(2)>Something that means a great deal to us is in this sea<thumbnail(220)>.
<topic()><thumbdown()><operator(30060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> is a Newtype. She is sensing something the rest of us cannot.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Judging by <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>'s movements, they appear to have been searching for something.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> says it holds an important meaning for us.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Judging by that force composition, it must be something very important.
rows.notes: Orchestrator: reworded to avoid a j/q glyph.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>I want you to trust <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>'s word here. We will recover what they found in these waters.
<topic()><operator(30080,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>. It seems the <book(37)>GX<endbook()>'s refit parts... the <color(6)>Divider<ce()><thumbnail(221)>, are finished.
rows.notes: "refit parts" for kansou-you parts, matching 4003030 slot 34.

rows.en: <operator(30080,1)><speed(2)>They are parts to boost the <book(37)>GX<endbook()>'s versatility. Make good use of them.
